name: linear-issue-mod
description: Claude Code mod: shows the Linear issue behind your current git branch in a band and a pane, lists the other Claude Code sessions and their issues, and warns about conflicts and scope drift

linearApiKey.title: Linear API key
linearApiKey.description: Personal API key (Linear → Settings → Security & access). Left empty, the LINEAR_API_KEY environment variable is used, then LINEAR_API_KEY in <repo>/.env.

teamKeys.title: Team keys
teamKeys.description: Comma-separated Linear team keys to look for in branch names (e.g. ENG, OPS). Left empty, your workspace's team keys are fetched from Linear.

registryFile.title: Sub-project registry
registryFile.description: Optional JSON file at the repo root listing sub-projects ({"sites":[{"key","path","active"}]}). When present, issue labels that match a key define the issue's scope, and edits outside it raise a drift toast.

pinCommand.title: Pin command
pinCommand.description: Name of one of your slash commands (without /) whose first argument is an issue id, e.g. issue-start. Running it pins that issue to the session.

pollMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often the issue is re-fetched from Linear.

showOtherSessions.title: Show other sessions
showOtherSessions.description: Share this session's issue with your other local Claude Code sessions (via ~/.claude/linear-issue-mod/sessions) and list theirs in the band.
